jobs.title: SOX and Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

McKesson is seeking a SOX and Compliance Analyst
to support enterprise governance, risk, and compliance initiatives across SAP, Identity Governance, Cybersecurity, and Internal Controls. This role will be responsible for administering SAP GRC platforms, supporting SOX compliance activities, managing user access governance processes through SailPoint, producing cybersecurity compliance reporting, and partnering with internal and external auditors to strengthen the organization's control environment.

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, compliance knowledge, and analytical problem-solving skills to improve control effectiveness, reduce risk, and support regulatory compliance across the enterprise. This position operates within McKesson's Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) organization and collaborates with Information Security, Internal Audit, Application Teams, and Business Stakeholders.

What You'll Do

Administer and support SAP GRC Access Control and Process Control solutions, including user provisioning, access requests, emergency access management, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) monitoring.
Execute SOX ITGC and automated control testing activities, including evidence collection, documentation, validation, and issue tracking.
Support SailPoint Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) processes, user access reviews, certification campaigns, role management, and provisioning workflows.
Develop and maintain cybersecurity compliance dashboards, risk reports, vulnerability tracking metrics, and executive reporting.
Partner with Information Security teams to monitor remediation efforts for identified vulnerabilities and control deficiencies.
Coordinate internal and external audit activities, provide audit evidence, and support walkthroughs and testing requests.
Track control exceptions and drive remediation plans through closure while ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve governance, compliance, automation, and operational effectiveness across GRC processes.

Basic Requirements

4+ years of experience in IT Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), IT Audit, SOX Compliance, Cybersecurity Compliance, Identity & Access Management, or related fields.
Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Security, Computer Science, Accounting, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Hands-on experience administering SAP GRC Access Control and/or SAP Process Control.
Experience performing SOX controls testing, audit support, evidence collection, and compliance documentation.
Experience supporting SailPoint Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) or similar IAM platforms.
Knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Experience working with cybersecurity compliance reporting, risk metrics, vulnerability management, or security control monitoring.
Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience with SAP S/4HANA environments and SAP security concepts.
Knowledge of NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or other cybersecurity and compliance frameworks.
Experience using Integrated Risk Management (IRM), GRC Automation, or Regulatory Technology (RegTech) platforms.
Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CGEIT, SAP GRC, Security+, or SailPoint certifications.
Experience developing compliance dashboards and executive-level reporting.
Knowledge of vulnerability management tools and remediation tracking processes.
Experience supporting large-scale audit programs across complex enterprise environments.
Proven track record of driving process improvements and compliance automation initiatives.
Technical experience across SAP Basis, HANA/Oracle/MSSQL database administration, SAP BusinessObjects, Linux administration, and Windows administration.
Platform experience across SAP RISE, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and other SAP SaaS deployments.
Experience with hyperscaler platforms, including Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Advanced Identity and Access Management experience, including SSO/MFA and authentication protocols or technologies such as OpenID, SAML, Kerberos, SPNego, LDAP, Active Directory, Okta, and SAP Identity Provider.
Privileged Access Management experience across OS, database, and application layers in SAP and non-SAP environments, including CyberArk.
Expertise in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), SAP GRC, and SailPoint.
Experience with SOX/SOC controls across OS, database, and application layers in SAP and non-SAP environments.

At McKesson, we care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse employee population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

Our Base Pay Range for this position

€56,300 - €93,800

jobs.title: Supply Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Summary:

Hands-on, tactical and operational role supporting end-to-end supply planning and product availability for consumer electronics programs. Focused on supply and demand balancing, purchase order execution, shipment tracking, and daily allocation, in support of the supply planners who own the portfolios. Success looks like clean execution under changing priorities, fast troubleshooting, and disciplined, repeatable processes.

Responsibilities:

Balance supply against demand across programs and channels; update total supply allocation daily based on inbound freight actuals and the supply projection model
Execute weekly purchase order release and troubleshoot order and commit issues on a timely basis
Support the ex-factory and supply commit processes with contract manufacturing sites
Review inbound freight to confirm receipt of supply at each DC; track shipments end to end and drive resolution of discrepancies
Upload allocation information and factory commits into Oracle Fusion on a scheduled basis
Support the weekly tactical S&OP process by preparing data and inputs for cross-functional teams
Help create and maintain inventory plans for finished goods across regional DCs
Build and maintain dashboards and ad hoc reporting; track supply chain KPIs for the portfolio
Identify supply issues and support communication, escalation, and coordination of resolution
Build strong working relationships with XFN partners: supply planners, freight, procurement, CE, and contract manufacturing
Document and help streamline existing processes

Required Skills:

Direct supply chain planning experience, hands-on in tactical and operational work: PO execution, shipment tracking, ex-factory and commit support
Demonstrated ability to balance supply and demand across multiple programs at once
Excellent with spreadsheets in general, including expert-level Excel and Google Sheets (large datasets, pivots, lookups, no handholding)
Systems experience with o9 and Oracle Fusion, understanding of ERP planning, order management, allocation, and fulfillment
Dashboard and ad hoc reporting experience; Tableau or similar BI tools a plus
Experience using AI tools and incorporating them into analysis and reporting workflows
Strong troubleshooting and discrepancy-resolution ability
Process-driven and detail-oriented; able to multitask and hold quality under shifting priorities
Excellent written and verbal communication
Ownership mindset with the ability to see tasks through to completion
Independent self-starter who can operate with minimal direction

Preferred:

Consumer electronics industry experience, ideally AR/VR
Experience coordinating with contract manufacturers and 3PL warehouses

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in supply chain, operations, industrial engineering, or business, with 2 to 4 years in a similar planning or supply chain execution role

Must-Have Skills:

6+ years hands-on supply chain planning/execution (PO execution, shipment tracking, commit support)
o9 and Oracle Fusion; ERP planning, order management, allocation, fulfillment
Expert Excel and Google Sheets — large datasets, pivots, lookups, unsupervised and reporting/dashboards (Tableau or similar a plus); comfort using AI tools in analysis workflows

Nice-to-have Skills:

Consumer electronics experience, ideally AR/VR

How many rounds of interviews:
1 - 2
Types of Interviews:
Technical/Behavioral
Interview Duration:
30 mins

jobs.title: Customer Success & Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Customer Success & Sales Representative is responsible for customer onboarding, engagement, retention, and account support, while also contributing to sales and customer account growth. The position serves as a primary point of contact for customers, supports implementation and training, demonstrates the company’s software platform to prospective customers, identifies new business opportunities, and promotes additional products and services to existing customers.

Primary Function:
Customer Success, Onboarding & Account Support
Secondary Functions:
Sales & Customer Account Growth

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Customer Success, Onboarding & Account Support

Coordinate customer onboarding, account setup, and training activities
Serve as a primary point of contact for customer questions and requests
Assist customers with platform access, user setup, and navigation
Support customer adoption, engagement, retention, and renewals
Conduct or support customer reviews and follow-up activities
Identify customer needs and recommend appropriate products and services
Document customer communications and account activities
Coordinate with Technical Operations and other departments to resolve customer issues

Sales & Customer Account Growth

Identify and develop relationships with prospective customers and new business opportunities
Qualify leads and gather customer requirements
Conduct software platform demonstrations and presentations for prospective customers
Present and sell company products, software, and services
Prepare proposals, quotations, and customer agreements
Follow up on leads, proposals, and sales opportunities
Identify and pursue upselling and cross-sell opportunities with existing customers
Support customer renewals, account expansion, and additional sales
Maintain accurate sales and customer information in the CRM system
Track sales activities, opportunities, pipeline, and results

Customer Service & Administrative Support

Respond to customer inquiries and coordinate timely resolution of issues
Maintain professional and timely customer communications
Maintain customer files, agreements, proposals, and supporting documentation
Support billing and renewal communications
Prepare customer and sales reports
Maintain accurate CRM and customer records.
Follow company procedures, quality standards, and documentation requirements.

Qualifications

Education

·      Bachelor’s degree is preferred in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Education, Workforce Development, or a related field.
·      Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

Experience

Two (2) or more years of experience in customer success, customer service, sales, account management, business development, or a related field.
Manufacturing industry experience preferred.
Experience with CRM systems and customer relationship management.
Experience conducting customer presentations, software demonstrations, or training sessions preferred.
Experience selling products or services and developing customer relationships preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong customer service, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
Technical understanding of training software and AI applications in talent development and tracking.
Ability to identify customer needs and recommend appropriate products and services
Ability to identify prospective customers and develop sales opportunities
Ability to conduct effective software demonstrations and presentations
Ability to identify and pursue upselling and cross-sell opportunities

·      The position occasionally requires standing for long periods of time while attending promotional events and the ability to lift up to 35 pounds.
Strong follow-up, organizational, and time-management skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and web-based applications. Experience with Salesforce is a plus.
Project management skills to prioritize and deliver projects on time and within scope.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured through a combination of customer success and sales performance, including:
Customer onboarding and adoption
Customer satisfaction, retention, and renewal
New prospective customers and qualified sales opportunities
Software platform demonstrations
New sales and sales conversion
Upsell and cross-sell activity and revenue
Customer account growth and expansion
Timely and accurate CRM documentation

Compensation 

$65,000 – $80,000 annually, based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated performance. Eligible for participation in the Company's performance incentive program, with additional earnings opportunities tied to customer success, account growth, and sales performance.

About us

NIMS is a 501(c)3 nonprofit that was formed in 1995 to develop and maintain a globally competitive American workforce. Our mission is to help organizations improve workforce performance by teaching them how to train and validate training with practical experiences that reflect what employees face on the job.

Equal Employment Opportunity

NIMS is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Benefits:

401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fairfax, VA 22030
